create_page_from_blocks.description: Make a Qwilr page from saved blocks in the order you choose, with your own quote sections, line items and variables. Each page made through the API uses a Qwilr credit, and once your credits run out Qwilr bills it on a monthly usage invoice.
create_page_from_blocks.name: create_page_from_blocks

parameters.description: The saved blocks to build the page from, in the order chosen.
parameters.name: block_ids

parameters.description: Settings for some of the blocks, keyed by the block's name or id. Each holds Qwilr's own fields: quoteSections and quoteSettings for a quote, substitutions, foldable, splashSettings or acceptSettings.
parameters.name: block_settings

parameters.description: The page's name, shown as its title in the browser.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Yes makes the page live so its link works; no (the default) keeps it a draft.
parameters.name: published

parameters.description: Each variable's API reference (from the Variables menu in Qwilr's editor) with its value, shown exactly as given. A list of rows fills a repeating variable.
parameters.name: substitutions

parameters.description: Tags for the page, separated by commas. Tags are case-sensitive.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Who owns the page; their details appear in its emails. Defaults to the person whose token is connected.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: Stop the page's link working this many days after it is published, 1 to 365. Leave empty for a link that does not expire.
parameters.name: expire_after_days

parameters.description: Your own keys and values, such as a deal id, kept on the page and sent with Qwilr's webhooks.
parameters.name: metadata

acceptance.description: Who accepted and the quote they chose; empty until accepted

customForm.description: Answers to the accept form's questions

auditTrailPdf.description: The audit trail PDF (it can take a few minutes)

quote.description: The quote they accepted, if the page has one

amount.description: The total they accepted, with tax

quoteSections.description: The sections and line items they chose

folderId.description: The folder holding the page; empty at the top level

collaboratorUrl.description: Your team's address for working on it together

editorUrl.description: Opens the page in Qwilr's editor

pdfUrl.description: Downloads the page as a PDF

publicUrl.description: The page's address, to send to buyers

metadata.description: Your own keys and values on the page

name.description: The page's name, its title in the browser

ownerId.description: The id of the user who owns the page

enabled.description: Whether Qwilr Pay is on for the page

requireOnAccept.description: Whether buyers pay as they accept

status.description: draft, live, accepting (partly accepted), accepted, declined or disabled

description: Make Qwilr proposals and quotes from templates or saved blocks, publish and update them, see who accepted and the quote they chose, manage quote taxes and webhook subscriptions, and start a workflow when a page is made or accepted.

qwilr_new_page_trigger.description: Runs when a page is made in your Qwilr account, in the editor or through the API, with its status, tags and links. Pages already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.folderId: The folder the page is in, empty at the top level
output.links: The page's links: publicUrl, editorUrl, collaboratorUrl, pdfUrl
output.metadata: Your own keys and values on the page
output.name: The page's name
output.ownerId: The id of the user who owns the page
output.status: draft, live, accepting, accepted, declined or disabled

qwilr_page_accepted_trigger.description: Runs when a proposal or quote is accepted by everyone who has to accept it, with who accepted, when, and the quote total. Pages accepted before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.acceptance: Who accepted (accepters with name, email and acceptedAt), the quote's amount and the audit trail PDF
output.folderId: The folder the page is in, empty at the top level
output.links: The page's links: publicUrl, editorUrl, collaboratorUrl, pdfUrl
output.metadata: Your own keys and values on the page
output.name: The page's name
output.ownerId: The id of the user who owns the page
output.status: draft, live, accepting, accepted, declined or disabled
